name: FlowDown AI
description: Privacy-first native AI workspace for iOS, iPadOS, and macOS with local models, OpenAI-compatible provider profiles, MCP client support, web search, attachments, memory, and Shortcuts automation.
when_to_use: Use FlowDown when a user wants a native AI app for iPhone, iPad, or Mac.
Use FlowDown when a user wants local model workflows through MLX or Apple Intelligence.
Use FlowDown when a user wants custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints, headers, and request bodies.
Use FlowDown when a user wants MCP client integration and Apple Shortcuts automation.
Use FlowDown when local-first storage and optional iCloud sync matter.

auth.mcp_credentials: user-supplied headers in the installed app
auth.cloud_sync: Apple CloudKit through the user's iCloud account
